topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I just can't catch a break. I move into what was supposed to be my fresh start, only to find this attic is a graveyard of someone else’s past. Boxes, old clothes, a broken bicycle. It's not just clutter; it's a mockery, a haunting reminder of lives I'll never know. I can't focus, can't breathe right when I think about the hours, no, days I'll have to spend sifting through this mess. I want to scream, but instead, I’m here, alone, staring at a mountain of someone else’s junk, wondering if I’ll ever feel at home here.
